chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahbub from Abdullah ibn Sinan said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the milk of the bull, so he said: 'It is what your wife suckled from your milk and the milk of your son who suckled from the milk of another woman, and it is forbidden.'

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.لَبَنِ الْفَحْلِ: Milk of the bull (a specific juristic case of cross-generational nursing)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of laban al-fahl (milk of the bull) in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the specific mechanism of 'laban al-fahl' (the bull's milk), where a woman suckles directly from a man, establishing a direct nursing bond (radha') between her and that man. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing direct suckling from indirect or secondary connections, thereby defining the precise scope of mahram relationships that prohibit marriage.
